title: Albuquerque's flying pig 'Ham-Let' up for sale as longtime hot air balloon pilot retires - NewsBreak
text:
By Bianca Hoops ,
38 minutes ago ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (KRQE) – It’s the world’s largest flying pig and something you can always count on seeing at the Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta. Now Ham-Let’s owner is retiring and putting him up for sale after this upcoming Balloon Fiesta.
Story continues below
Doug Gantt has been a hot air balloon pilot for 35 years; he even moved here to Albuquerque for Balloon Fiesta and his love for flying. Now at 75 years old, he’s ready to retire. “Ballooning has been such a big part of my life for a long time. I mean, I bought my first balloon when my son was one year old, he’s grown up with balloons, he’s now a hot air balloon pilot,” said Gantt.
You may recognize his iconic “When Pigs Fly” hot air balloon at Balloon Fiesta every year. The pig’s name is “Ham-Let,” and he’s been around for 23 years. Now, Ham-Let is up for sale. “There comes a point in time where you recognize that your skills aren’t as good as they used to be. And if, if you’re on to yourself, you just need to know when to take the car keys away from grandma, you know, and that’s where I am,” said Gantt.
Gantt said this upcoming fiesta will be the last time he will fly Ham-Let, and after he plans to pass on his prized possession. As for the future of the world’s largest flying pig at Balloon Fiestas to come, “It’s entirely up to whoever buys the balloon. It’d be nice if it stayed here in the United States and then I’d be able to see it every year coming to fiesta because I plan on volunteering with them in the future going forward.”
Gantt said piloting has been like no other experience; his favorite memory is his first Balloon Fiesta in 2001. “I’ll always remember my first flight off of fiesta field because it was just amazing with having over 500 pilots in balloons in various stages of inflation on the field and taking off,” said Gantt.
Gantt still plans to attend Balloon Fiesta after retirement and wants to remain close to Albuquerque.
Gantt is selling his hot air balloon for $42,500, which would include the basket, fans, and other gear used for flight. You can catch Ham-Let at this year’s Balloon Fiesta, every day, including the Special Shapes Rodeo.
